name: Revolutionary United Front
alt: Revolutionary United Front of Sierra Leone

predecessors.name: Sierra Leone
predecessors.text: eastern Sierra Leone, entered when the RUF 'led elements of the National Patriotic Front of Liberia across the Liberian border'

successors.name: Sierra Leone
successors.text: the rebel-held areas: the Eastern Province and the border strip, where 'UN forces moved into rebel-held areas and began to disarm rebel soldiers' in 2001

ledger.x: 1991: the RUF takes the east and south.
1993-03: the army drives the RUF back.
1994: the RUF holds the Eastern Province again.
2002-01-18: the rebel-held areas return to the state.
2002-01-18: the war ends and the RUF ceases to hold land.

wars.name: Sierra Leone Civil War
wars.outcome: The RUF lost: Kabbah declared the war over on 18 January 2002 and the movement became a political party; about 50,000 were killed between 1991 and 2001.

certainty.note: The rebel-held areas are described as 'large swathes' and 'much of' provinces; none of the pages opened gives a front line, a district list or an area.
